newsitem.title: FRANCE: French far-right fake policemen held after clash.
newsitem.headline: French far-right fake policemen held after clash.

text.p: Four members of France's far-right National Front who posed as policemen were being held on Monday after clashing with anti-Front protesters in the eastern town of Strasbourg, police said.
They said the demonstrators complained that the four, who belong to the Front's security service, beat them on Sunday.
France-Inter radio said the fake policemen had been making arrests and identity checks. It said a member of the elected regional council of the central Auvergne region was among them.
Police said the four would be handed over to a state prosecutor and prosecuted for passing themselves off as police.
Tens of thousands of anti-Front militants gathered at the weekend in Strasbourg to protest at the congress of Jean-Marie Le Pen's party which was due to end later in the day.
